_comment: Sparse disable normalizes dependents: explicit reasoning.supported=false suppresses effort values/defaults and toggle to null/false with the asserting evidence. Baseline rejects [capabilities] at startup.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "m-a"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o"

[capabilities.overrides."m-a".reasoning]
supported = false
name: m4_capability_override_false_normalize
